method.firefox_prefs: LaunchServices new instance with explicit disposable profile and native PID identified by profile argument; startup/check/telemetry prefs scoped to that profile
method.idle: one pair of samples from 1.5 s after readiness; convert Darwin CPU ticks to ns with the observed Mach timebase; matched process identities only
method.memory: Darwin RUSAGE_INFO_V0 physical footprint and RSS, separate host tree and estimated launch-associated WebKit helpers
method.profiles: fresh disposable comparator profile, followed by process relaunch with reused profile; WRY dedicated persistent fixture store shared across its launches
method.ready: elapsed from new process launch to last local page load beacon; shell-only poll when no webview; not first paint
method.temperature: OS caches not flushed; first and repeat denote process order only, not cold disk boots
method.workload: same small loopback page, no-store, no page scripts except the load beacon; all requested tabs must report
